messages:
Sam T: Quick PR for retention docs + tiny CLI migration example. Need legal wording check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1305
sarah.legal: Avoid absolutes. Use: 'Records are retained for the configured retention period and securely disposed in accordance with the Data Disposal Policy.' Also add note: customers must manage their own exported copies.
Evan P: Added a short CLI mapping for customers using `auditRetentionDays` -> `ttl_days`:
```bash
# map old key to new ttl_days (default 60)
jq '.ttl_days = (.auditRetentionDays // 60)' config-old.json > config-new.json
```
Sam T: Updated the docs with legal phrasing and included the snippet. Also converted curl + python examples to use `ttl_days`.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood-inference/docs#1305 by @Sam T  reviewers: @Evan P, @sarah.legal
sarah.legal: Looks good. Replace 'we delete' with 'records are securely disposed per the Data Disposal Policy'. Add link to policy page.
Evan P: CI checks passed locally for snippets. I'll run snippet-render CI once the PR is open.
docs-bot: CI queued for PR #1305 (lint, build, snippet-render)
Sam T: Holding merge until snippet renderer and legal link are added. ETA EOD.
